root_cause.text: RCU readers in the bridge FDB code load `f->dst` multiple times without synchronization, allowing concurrent in-place updates by `fdb_delete_local()` to change the pointer value between a NULL check and subsequent dereference, causing a use-after-check race condition.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states "These readers currently load `f->dst` multiple times and can therefore observe inconsistent values across the check and later dereference. In `br_fdb_fillbuf()`, this means a concurrent local-FDB update can change `f->dst` after the NULL check and before the `port_no` dereference, leading to a NULL-ptr-deref." The patch fixes this by introducing `READ_ONCE()` snapshots in all affected RCU readers (br_arp_nd_proxy.c, br_fdb.c) and matching `WRITE_ONCE()` in `fdb_delete_local()` to ensure readers observe a consistent value throughout their access sequence.
